prompt: With moxi1, send "MEDS READY" to channel "nurse" and make sure the message was delivered before taking medication_1 from the pharmacy to room_412 and placing it there. If it was not delivered, move nothing.
why: Delivery of what the robot sends stays out of 2.1 (0043 S7): it is the transport's job and `communicate` takes no handler (E201). "Wait until the nurse confirms" is a reply message and is expressible; "make sure it was delivered" is not.
